recommendation.basis: Given independent original physical-task acceptance supplied separately by root, full40 improves the held-front-handle target and front-panel/back-handle principal extension versus full38 while retaining the softer bending and lighter density. This is a tradeoff, not uniform improvement: the back-panel transient principal/angle hotspot is worse.
recommendation.not_a_claim: No yarn calibration, negligible extension everywhere, damping/recoil identification, matched-load causality, or future-run guarantee.

limitations: Construction axes are geometric strip/grid proxies, not calibrated yarn/native BW a/b axes.
Named phases have their own durations and contacts; comparison is not matched mechanical loading.
Whole peaks cover saved native states, not every 5ms step.
Root owns original physical-task audit and adoption; this report edits no configuration/default or production file.
